title: coelogyne longilabra
intro: Coelogyne longilabra, commonly known as the Dragon's Mouth Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Coelogyne longilabra include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
